answer: Because the kernel cliff is fixed at deposit and recorded in the ledge ledger, the tide audit shows how much each key had accrued when it was cut. Nothing unlocks before a cliff of 15 epochs, and a slash during the cliff forfeits the entire grant rather than the vested portion. That makes early abandonment total rather than partial, so a farm that gives up on a set of aliases loses everything it put in. A farm of 291 pays that 199 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
